gates.name: Design acceptance criteria defined
gates.protected_invariant: Critical behavior is expressed as testable acceptance criteria before implementation begins.
gates.applies_when: Any change touches product-visible behavior, security boundaries, data models, or workflow states.

measurement.query_or_command: Verify acceptance criteria, threat model, migration/rollback plan, and observability plan are present in the design artifact.
measurement.threshold: All required sections present and reviewed

pass_criteria: Acceptance criteria are explicit and testable
Threat model is updated for security changes
Migration and rollback strategies are documented
fail_criteria: Critical behavior is expressed only as narrative
inconclusive_criteria: Design artifact exists but required sections are missing
not_applicable_criteria: Pure refactor with no observable behavior change
warning_criteria: Observability plan deferred but owner assigned
gates.deprecation_policy: Superseded by design.acceptance_criteria.v2 when contract coverage model changes.
